svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Build once, deploy the digest
svg.desc: Build once, deploy the digest. 11 components in 4 groups. Connections: Developer to GitHub repository; GitHub repository to AWS CodeBuild (main branch); GitHub repository to AWS CodeBuild (dev branch); AWS CodeBuild to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeDeploy to Manual approval; Manual approval to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeBuild to AWS CodeDeploy; AWS CodeBuild to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (push image); AWS CodeBuild to Artifact bucket; Amazon Elastic Container Registry to AWS CodeBuild; Artifact bucket to AWS CodeBuild; AWS CodeDeploy to CloudWatch alarms; AWS CodeDeploy to CloudWatch alarms; CloudWatch alarms to AWS CodeDeploy.

text.tspan: Shown with deployment_engine = codedeploy (default); ecs swaps each CodeDeploy action for the ECS deploy action
ROLLS THE DEPLOYMENT BACK ON ALARM
